o.text: Borrowed from Persian دُوران, from Arabic دَوَرَان (dawarān).

From Russian холоди́льник (xolodílʹnik). The letter i becoming an e appears to be a hypercorrection, since in Russian, the letter е (je) can be pronounced similarly to the letter и (i); see гепа́рд (gepárd), for example.
